sloka: सा नूनम् आर्या मम राक्षसेन हिअभ्याहृता खम् समुपेत्य भीरुः ।अपस्वरम् सु स्वर विप्रलापाभयेन विक्रन्दितवति अभीक्ष्णम् ॥३-६३-७॥
transliteration: sā nūnam āryā mama rākṣasena hiabhyāhṛtā kham samupetya bhīruḥ ।apasvaram su svara vipralāpābhayena vikranditavati abhīkṣṇam ॥3-63-7॥

translations.english: The timid princess of mine forcibly carried away into the sky by a demon must have again and again cried aloud out of fear in a broken voice.
